interpy_bg Package

The interpy_bg package provides a feedforward neural network library for 5D → 1D interpolation. It includes functionality for training, testing, plotting, and logging.

Bases: object

Feedforward neural network for 5D to 1 interpolation.

Number of input features (fixed at 5).

Type:

Type:

list[int]

Number of output neurons (fixed at 1).

int

L2 regularization parameter.

float

Complete list of layer sizes including input, hidden, output.

list[int]

Weight matrices for each layer connection.

biases

Bias vectors for each layer (excluding input layer).

activation(z)[source]

Apply the sigmoid activation function element-wise to the input. Numerically stable version to avoid overflow for large negative values.

Return type:

ndarray

Parameters:

z (np.ndarray) – Input array of any shape.

Returns:

Sigmoid activation applied element-wise to keep the same shape as z.

Return type:

np.ndarray

activation_deriv(z)[source]

Derivative of the sigmoid activation function applied element-wise. The derivative is set as sigmoid(z) * (1 - sigmoid(z)).

Return type:

ndarray

Parameters:

z (np.ndarray) – Input array of any shape (pre-activation values).

Returns:

Element-wise derivative of the sigmoid, same shape as z.

Return type:

np.ndarray

backprop(X, y, y_hat)[source]

Calculate the gradients of the cost function w.r.t. to weights and biases using backpropagation.

Return type:

tuple[list[ndarray], list[ndarray]]

Parameters:

  • X (np.ndarray) – Input data of shape (N, 5), where N is the number of data points.

  • y (np.ndarray) – True target values of shape (N, 1).

  • y_hat (np.ndarray) – Predicted target values of shape (N, 1).

Returns:

Two lists:

  • dW: list of np.ndarray, gradients of weights for each layer

  • db: list of np.ndarray, gradients of biases for each layer

Return type:

tuple

cost_function(X, y)[source]

Compute the cost (loss) of the neural network for given inputs and targets.

The cost equals mean squared error (MSE) plus L2 regularisation on the weights.

Return type:

float

Parameters:

  • X (np.ndarray) – Input data of shape (N, 5), where N is the number of data points.

  • y (np.ndarray) – True target values of shape (N, 1).

Returns:

Scalar cost value.

Return type:

float
